description: Explains how to add the GPU of the machine this agent runs on to AmpleRun, so its owner earns from rentals. Returns the one-line installer command, the steps and the earnings links. It runs nothing itself. The installer needs root, so ask the machine's owner before running it, and the owner must approve the machine from the approve_url it prints: nothing is listed without that approval.
name: host_this_machine
title: Earn with this machine's GPU
